headline: Open Access Woodland Managed by Forestry England
reservation: Wendover Woods is an open access site managed by Forestry England; while entry to the woodland is generally open, specific activities like Go Ape or equipment rentals require separate booking. Check the Forestry England website for current parking payment systems or seasonal event requirements.

days.title: Woodland Discovery and Escarpment Views

stops.name: Wendover Woods
stops.detail: Explore 325 hectares of woodland featuring waymarked walks, a fitness trail, and the highest point in the Chilterns at 267 meters.

days.driving: Allow 15-30 minutes for local transfer; conditions vary
days.note: A relaxed pace allows time for the café and play trails; spring visitors should look for bluebell displays.

intel.title: Forestry England Facilities
intel.text: Parking is available on-site at Wendover Woods, which serves as the primary hub for the café and trailheads. Evidence does not specify current parking fees or capacity limits, so check local signage upon arrival.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: Evidence does not provide specific mobile signal strength for the woods or Boddington hillfort area. Visitors should download maps from Forestry England in advance to ensure navigation without data.

intel.title: Gateway Supplies
intel.text: The town of Wendover serves as the primary gateway for supplies and services. There are no fuel or grocery services mentioned within the woodland site itself beyond the café.

intel.title: Seasonal Interests
intel.text: Spring features bluebells while fall offers changing leaf colors across the escarpment. Winter provides crisp conditions for walking, though daylight hours are significantly shorter.

intel.title: Trail Navigation
intel.text: Waymarked walks of varying lengths are available, and leaflets can be obtained at the Wendover Tourist Information centre. The site includes archaeological interest at the Boddington hillfort.

plan.arrival: Arrival involves navigating to the Chilterns escarpment near Wendover for rental drop-off or supply runs before heading to the Forestry England managed woodland.
plan.vehicle: Standard passenger cars are suitable for reaching the established parking areas; check local road restrictions for larger RVs.
plan.goldenHour: Boddington hillfort provides an elevated viewpoint for seasonal light, though specific sunrise/sunset visibility depends on tree cover.
